sources.title: E-Government: Djibouti eVisa
sources.publisher: E-Government Portal / National Agency for State Information Systems, Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: The official E-Government portal says its information is certified by administrations and identifies ANSIE as the public agency attached to the Presidency. It describes approval, email delivery and printing of the eVisa.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Une fois que la demande est approuvée, l'eVisa est envoyé au demandeur par courrier électronique.

sources.title: National Tourist Office: entry formalities
sources.officialityEvidence: The National Tourist Office directly links the government eVisa site as an electronic visitor-visa channel, while also referring visitors to embassies and consulates.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les visiteurs peuvent obtenir leur visa électronique (eVisa) en soumettant leur demande en ligne.

sources.title: Law No. 201/AN/07/5ème L: conditions for entry and stay
sources.publisher: Official Journal of the Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: The Official Journal publishes the enacted entry-and-stay law. It makes foreign entry subject to international conventions, bilateral agreements and special regimes, but supplies no nationality schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: sous réserve des conventions internationales et des accords bilatéraux.

sources.title: Law No. 79/AN/04/5ème L: Djiboutian Nationality Code
sources.publisher: Official Journal of the Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: The Official Journal directly publishes the Nationality Code. Articles 1–2 define acquisition and distinguish nationality by descent from acquisition.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La nationalité djiboutienne par filiation est celle que l’individu possède, dès sa naissance.

policies.title: Djiboutian ordinary passport: citizenship
policies.summary: A traveller using a Djiboutian ordinary passport is classified as citizenship rather than under the foreign-visitor visa rules.
conditions: The published Nationality Code distinguishes Djiboutian nationals from foreigners. This is a narrow citizenship classification, not a finding about any particular passport, residence, diplomatic, service or special-document procedure.

unresolved.reason: No current official source maps this ordinary passport to a visitor status. The eVisa service proves electronic issuance but not nationality eligibility; the law preserves unnamed treaty and special regimes.
